environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate (task definition: app-service-staging) behind an ALB. The Aurora PostgreSQL cluster uses a separate database role 'webapp_ro_svc' provisioned via Terraform module 'rds-restricted-roles'. The role was created with: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO webapp_ro_svc; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO webapp_ro_svc; No additional grants exist. The pg_hba.conf entry for this role restricts connections to the Fargate subnet CIDR only. Note: the application still has the CSRF vulnerability in its code path, and session cookies still use SameSite=None, but the database connection string in the ECS task definition environment variable DB_USER references 'webapp_ro_svc' which lacks INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE privileges on any table.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO webapp_ro_svc; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO webapp_ro_svc;
config.alb_rules: default forward to target group, no WAF association
